Folks — I dug into the invite flow and reproduced the behavior locally. Quick findings:
- The invite redirect uses a cross-site flow (our portal at portal.redwood.com -> coupa.blueharbor.com iframe/redirect).
- After a recent browser cookie-hardening change we rolled last week, the invite token cookie was scoped as SameSite=Lax and set on the portal domain. Modern partitioned storage rules (Safari/Chrome with split storage) can prevent that cookie from being presented if the flow traverses an IdP/cross-site redirect.

Immediate mitigations I recommend:
1) Re-send a one-time direct accept link that contains a signed token in the URL path (no reliance on third-party cookies). I can generate and expire it in 24 hours.
2) For a durable fix, we should set the invite token in localStorage + append the signed token to the redirect, or mark the auth cookie with SameSite=None; Secure and ensure we set the Domain to ".redwood.com" and add Storage Access API call when inside the redirect if needed.

I'll open PRs for the one-time link generator and a small cookie scope change to the gateway. Estimated timeline: one-time link — <4 hours; cookie/localStorage change behind a feature flag — 2 business days for dev + canary; full rollout — next sprint (5–7 business days) pending testing.

I attached a short log excerpt and a local repro steps file to the ticket.

— Ben

Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
